title: WebAssembly analytic functions vertical slice
objective: Provide host-neutral arbitrary-precision Arb/Acb analytic batch ABIs and a WebAssembly backend for Riemann zeta jets/batches, Dirichlet L batches, quadratic Dedekind completion, gamma completion primitives, plotting tiles, and browser parity vectors
references: SageMath zeta and Dirichlet L semantics

oracles: FLINT native Node provider and mpmath public references
Node and browser parity vector digests

handoff.summary: Added a host-neutral versioned packed-decimal Arb/Acb core and bounded grow-on-demand Wasm adapter for Riemann zeta jets/batches, Dirichlet L batches, quadratic Dedekind zeta and completion, Riemann xi, and complex gamma. The browser backend preserves arbitrary-precision decimal values plus accuracy/enclosure diagnostics, matches the existing FLINT provider method signatures, and converts to binary64 only in explicit synchronous tiled plotting. Focused JS and native FLINT tests pass on Linux x64; the exact pushed revision also passed the native core on Linux ARM64 and the JS/backend corpus on native Windows x64.
risks: The pinned CoWasm toolchain was still being prepared during implementation, so the final real-reactor compile/browser receipt remains an integration gate rather than being replaced by a fake success.
The full portable suite passes except for the expected shared architecture classification failures for the four new C/H files; this lane intentionally did not edit central inventories.

Native Windows uses the existing exact FLINT provider fallback until the new shared sources are linked into the production Wasm reactor; the JavaScript transport and validation corpus passes on Windows.
next_steps: Classify analytic_batch_core.c/.h, flint-wasm/src/analytic.c, and the native C test in the central native-code and Wasm capability inventories.
Link the two implementation sources and declared analytic exports into the generated production FLINT Wasm closure, then run the real reactor and public Chromium vectors.

Construct createAnalyticWasmBackend with ComplexField serialize/materialize callbacks and a generated Dirichlet-resource-to-modulus resolver, then merge its runtime-compatible methods into the browser FLINT backend.
